senses.gloss: (b. h.; cmp. חזז , s. v. חֲזָזִית) [to sting, be pointed, flinty;] to be hard, strong, v. עַז.
(of color) to be bright, intense. Sifra Thazr., Neg., Par. 2, ch. II, v. כָּהָה.
ה׳ פנים to set one’s face against; to dare, be insolent.
units: <cite ref="Bava Batra 131a:5">B. Bath. 131ᵃ</cite> <he>והֵעַזְתִּי פני</he>, v. <cite ref="J00370"><he>יַלְדּוּת</he></cite>.
Ber. 62ᵃ עד כאן הֵעַזְתָּ פניך ברבך hast thou dared so much against thy teacher (as to enter into his private rooms)? Zeb. 102ᵃ הָעֵיז פניך בו defy him

<cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 109:7">Midr. Till. to Ps. CXVIII, 7</cite> <he>תָּעֵיזּוּ לבבכם</he> (or <he>תָּעִיזוּ</he>, fr. <cite ref="P00215"><he>עוּז</he></cite>) strengthen your hearts, take courage.

senses.gloss: to become strong; to be daring, defiant.
units: <cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 9:20">Midr. Till. to IX, 20</cite> (ref. to <he>יָעֹז</he>, <cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 9:20">ib.</cite>) <he>אל יִתְעַזְּזוּן במלכותן ואל יתעזזון בשלותן</he> let them not be defiant on account of their royal power, or on account of their prosperity; (ed. Bub., Chald. <he>לא יתע׳ במלכותיהן ובלישניהון</he> let them not be daring with their power or their tongues); Yalk. Ps. 645.
